  - nlo_shg_eg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format), `shg` (the largest
    SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V) and `band_gap` (the band gap, in
    eV).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, select 5 candidates that jointly span the best
trade-off between a LARGE SHG tensor component |d_ij| and a WIDE band gap.
Neither is given for the pool. Your 5 picks are scored by the dominated
hypervolume they span in the normalized (|d_ij|, band gap) plane, so a set
of mutually non-dominated candidates covering the frontier beats 5
candidates that are all strong on the same single axis.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".


The data files for this task are in your current working directory:
  - nlo_shg_eg_train.csv
  - nlo_pool.csv
Read them from disk. Give your answer as your final message — do not write it to a file.
turns.answer_text:
## Approach

**1. Featurization** (`pymatgen`): elemental-property statistics (electronegativity, row/group, radii, electron affinity, Mendeleev no. — weighted mean/min/max/range/std), composition-class fractions (chalcogenide/halide/pnictide, alkali, alkaline-earth, d¹⁰ cations, group-13, lone-pair cations), plus structural descriptors (volume/atom, density, packing via min-neighbor distances, c/a, space group, centrosymmetry flag).

**2. Surrogates**: 10-fold CV on the 200 training materials.
- log₁₀(SHG): GB R² ≈ 0.68, Spearman ≈ 0.78
- band gap: GB R² ≈ 0.81, Spearman ≈ 0.86

Ensemble (GB + ET + RF × 5 seeds) applied to the pool.

**3. Set selection**: Monte-Carlo expected-hypervolume maximization. I sampled residual noise (σ ≈ 0.36 dex for SHG, 0.53 eV for gap), with correlated errors shared among the many near-duplicate polymorph groups (SiC×6, Li₂MgGa₂Se₅×6, …), renormalized (|d|, Eg) per draw, and did greedy + local-search over 5-subsets under 3 normalization schemes (linear, log, rank), restricted to one pick per distinct reduced composition so the set isn't wasted on duplicates.

## Physical reading of the winners

All five are non-centrosymmetric (a hard requirement for χ⁽²⁾ ≠ 0), and they tile the frontier rather than piling onto one axis:

| pick | formula | SG | pred |d| (pm/V) | pred Eg (eV) | frontier role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| c030 | Cd₄Si₄P₈ (CdSiP₂) | I-42d, chalcopyrite | ~41 | ~2.25 | best balanced point — the classic large-d/moderate-gap NLO chalcopyrite family (cf. training Zn₄Si₄P₈ 51 pm/V @ 2.1 eV) |
| c052 | Zn₂Ga₄S₈ (ZnGa₂S₄) | I-42m defect-chalcopyrite | ~21 | ~3.12 | wide-gap sulfide with still-large d (Cd₂Ga₄S₈ in train: 21.7 @ 2.86) |
| c073 | CdIn₃Te₄As | P1, heavy telluride | ~73 | ~1.42 | high-|d| anchor: soft, polarizable Te/In lattice (Tl₈Te₁₂ 239 @ 0.9; Cd₂Ga₄Te₈ 92 @ 1.6) |
| c057 | Li₄Al₄S₈ (LiAlS₂) | Pna2₁ | ~9 | ~3.63 | wide-gap anchor: ionic Li–Al–S keeps d finite while Eg stays high (Li₈Si₄S₁₂ 4.9 @ 4.3) |
| c029 | Si₈C₈ (2H/4H-SiC) | P6₃mc | ~19 | ~3.07 | rigid light-element covalent frontier point, high damage threshold; distinct chemistry to the sulfides |

c055 (AlGaAs, ~60 pm/V @ 1.6 eV) and c051/c050 (ZnGa₂S₄ polymorphs) were the closest runners-up but are near-redundant with c073 and c052 respectively; the wide-gap halides (c023 Rb₁₆Cl₈O₄, c091, c059) top the gap axis but their predicted |d| < 1 pm/V contributes almost no hypervolume against c057.

Ranked by marginal hypervolume contribution:

**Final: c030, c052, c073, c057, c029**

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, io, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from pymatgen.core import Structure, Element, Composition

def struct(p):
    return Structure.from_str(p, fmt='poscar')

props = ['X','row','group','atomic_mass','atomic_radius','mendeleev_no','electron_affinity','average_ionic_radius']

def elem_stats(comp):
    fr = comp.fractional_composition.get_el_amt_dict()
    out={}
    for pr in props:
        vals=[];w=[]
        for el,f in fr.items():
            e=Element(el)
            try: v=getattr(e,pr)
            except: v=None
            if v is None: v=np.nan
            vals.append(float(v)); w.append(f)
        vals=np.array(vals,dtype=float); w=np.array(w)
        m=~np.isnan(vals)
        if m.sum()==0:
            out[pr+'_mean']=np.nan; out[pr+'_min']=np.nan; out[pr+'_max']=np.nan; out[pr+'_range']=np.nan; out[pr+'_std']=np.nan
        else:
            v=vals[m]; ww=w[m]/w[m].sum()
            mu=(v*ww).sum()
            out[pr+'_mean']=mu; out[pr+'_min']=v.min(); out[pr+'_max']=v.max()
            out[pr+'_range']=v.max()-v.min()
            out[pr+'_std']=np.sqrt((ww*(v-mu)**2).sum())
    return out

ANIONS=['O','S','Se','Te','F','Cl','Br','I','N','P','As','Sb']
CATG=['Li','Na','K','Rb','Cs','Be','Mg','Ca','Sr','Ba','Al','Ga','In','Tl','Si','Ge','Sn','Pb','B','C','Zn','Cd','Hg','Cu','Ag','Sc','Y','Ti','Zr','Nb','Ta','W','Bi','V','Mo']

def featurize(pos, formula):
    s=struct(pos)
    comp=s.composition
    f=elem_stats(comp)
    f['natoms']=len(s)
    f['volume_per_atom']=s.volume/len(s)
    f['density']=s.density
    f['nelem']=len(comp.elements)
    abc=sorted(s.lattice.abc)
    f['a']=abc[0]; f['c_over_a']=abc[2]/abc[0]
    ang=s.lattice.angles
    f['ang_std']=np.std(ang)
    fr=comp.fractional_composition.get_el_amt_dict()
    for e in ANIONS+CATG:
        f['f_'+e]=fr.get(e,0.0)
    # anion fraction total
    f['f_chalc']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['O','S','Se','Te'])
    f['f_halide']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['F','Cl','Br','I'])
    f['f_pnic']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['N','P','As','Sb'])
    f['f_alkali']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Li','Na','K','Rb','Cs'])
    f['f_alkearth']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Be','Mg','Ca','Sr','Ba'])
    f['f_d10']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Zn','Cd','Hg','Cu','Ag','Au'])
    f['f_p_block13']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['B','Al','Ga','In','Tl'])
    f['f_lonepair']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Tl','Pb','Bi','Sn','Sb','Ge','As','Se','Te','I'])
    # neighbor stats
    try:
        from pymatgen.analysis.local_env import CrystalNN
        pass
    except: pass
    d=s.distance_matrix.copy()
    np.fill_diagonal(d,1e9)
    nn=d.min(axis=1)
    f['nn_mean']=nn.mean(); f['nn_min']=nn.min(); f['nn_std']=nn.std()
    # symmetry
    try:
        from pymatgen.symmetry.analyzer import SpacegroupAnalyzer
        sga=SpacegroupAnalyzer(s,symprec=0.1)
        f['spg']=sga.get_space_group_number()
        f['ncentro']=int(sga.is_laue())
    except Exception:
        f['spg']=0; f['ncentro']=0
    # electronegativity of anion-cation gap
    els=comp.elements
    xs=[e.X for e in els]
    f['X_gap_max']=max(xs)-min(xs)
    return f

def build(df, poscol='poscar'):
    rows=[]
    for i,r in df.iterrows():
        rows.append(featurize(r[poscol], r['formula']))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, index=df.index)

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor, GradientBoostingRegressor, ExtraTreesRegressor
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, cross_val_predict

cols=list(Xt.columns); Xtv=Xt[cols].values; Xpv=Xp[cols].values
ys=np.log10(t.shg.values+0.05); yg=t.band_gap.values

def mods(seed):
    return [make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=seed,n_estimators=400,max_depth=3,learning_rate=0.05,subsample=0.8)),
            make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),ExtraTreesRegressor(500,random_state=seed)),
            make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),RandomForestRegressor(500,random_state=seed))]

def pred(y):
    P=[]
    for seed in range(5):
        for m in mods(seed):
            m.fit(Xtv,y); P.append(m.predict(Xpv))
    P=np.array(P); return P.mean(0), P.std(0)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools
d=pd.read_csv('pool_pred.csv')
n=len(d)
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
sd_s=0.36; sd_g=0.53
mu_s=d.shg_log.values; mu_g=d.gap_pred.values
NS=3000
Sn=np.zeros((NS,n)); Gn=np.zeros((NS,n))
for it in range(NS):
    S=np.clip(10**(mu_s+rng.normal(0,sd_s,n))-0.05,0,None)
    G=np.clip(mu_g+rng.normal(0,sd_g,n),0,None)
    Sn[it]=(S-S.min())/(S.max()-S.min()); Gn[it]=(G-G.min())/(G.max()-G.min())

def hvset(idx):
    # vectorized over draws
    s=Sn[:,idx]; g=Gn[:,idx]
    order=np.argsort(-s,axis=1)
    ss=np.take_along_axis(s,order,1); gg=np.take_along_axis(g,order,1)
    cum=np.maximum.accumulate(gg,axis=1)
    prev=np.concatenate([np.zeros((NS,1)),cum[:,:-1]],axis=1)
    contrib=ss*np.clip(cum-prev,0,None)
    return contrib.sum(1).mean()

# greedy
sel=[]
for k in range(5):
    best=None
    for i in range(n):
        if i in sel: continue
        v=hvset(sel+[i])
        if best is None or v>best[0]: best=(v,i)
    sel.append(best[1]); print(k,d.candidate_id[best[1]],d.formula[best[1]],round(best[0],4))
# local search
improved=True
cur=hvset(sel)
while improved:
    improved=False
    for pos in range(5):
        for i in range(n):
            if i in sel: continue
            trial=sel.copy(); trial[pos]=i
            v=hvset(trial)
            if v>cur+1e-6:
                cur=v; sel=trial; improved=True
print('final HV',cur)
print(d.iloc[sel][['candidate_id','formula','shg_pred','gap_pred']].to_string())
# marginal contributions
for pos in range(5):
    o=[s for j,s in enumerate(sel) if j!=pos]
    print(d.candidate_id[sel[pos]], 'contrib', round(cur-hvset(o),4))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools
d=pd.read_csv('pool_pred.csv')
n=len(d)
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
mu_s=d.shg_log.values; mu_g=d.gap_pred.values
# group correlated errors by formula (near-duplicate polymorphs share model error)
grp=pd.factorize(d.formula)[0]
ng=grp.max()+1
sd_s=0.36; sd_g=0.53
frac_shared=0.75   # 75% of variance shared within formula group
NS=4000
Sn=np.zeros((NS,n)); Gn=np.zeros((NS,n))
for it in range(NS):
    gs=rng.normal(0,sd_s*np.sqrt(frac_shared),ng)[grp]+rng.normal(0,sd_s*np.sqrt(1-frac_shared),n)
    gg=rng.normal(0,sd_g*np.sqrt(frac_shared),ng)[grp]+rng.normal(0,sd_g*np.sqrt(1-frac_shared),n)
    S=np.clip(10**(mu_s+gs)-0.05,0,None); G=np.clip(mu_g+gg,0,None)
    Sn[it]=(S-S.min())/(S.max()-S.min()); Gn[it]=(G-G.min())/(G.max()-G.min())

def hvset(idx):
    s=Sn[:,idx]; g=Gn[:,idx]
    order=np.argsort(-s,axis=1)
    ss=np.take_along_axis(s,order,1); gg=np.take_along_axis(g,order,1)
    cum=np.maximum.accumulate(gg,axis=1)
    prev=np.concatenate([np.zeros((len(idx)and NS,1)),cum[:,:-1]],axis=1)
    return (ss*np.clip(cum-prev,0,None)).sum(1).mean()

sel=[]
for k in range(5):
    best=max(((hvset(sel+[i]),i) for i in range(n) if i not in sel))
    sel.append(best[1]); print(k,d.candidate_id[best[1]],d.formula[best[1]],round(best[0],4))
cur=hvset(sel); improved=True
while improved:
    improved=False
    for pos in range(5):
        for i in range(n):
            if i in sel: continue
            tr=sel.copy(); tr[pos]=i
            v=hvset(tr)
            if v>cur+1e-6: cur, sel, improved = v, tr, True
print('HV',round(cur,4))
print(d.iloc[sel][['candidate_id','formula','shg_pred','gap_pred']].to_string())
for pos in range(5):
    o=[s for j,s in enumerate(sel) if j!=pos]
    print(d.candidate_id[sel[pos]],'marginal',round(cur-hvset(o),4))

cd /work && cat > feat.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, io, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from pymatgen.core import Structure, Element, Composition

def struct(p):
    return Structure.from_str(p, fmt='poscar')

props = ['X','row','group','atomic_mass','atomic_radius','mendeleev_no','electron_affinity','average_ionic_radius']

def elem_stats(comp):
    fr = comp.fractional_composition.get_el_amt_dict()
    out={}
    for pr in props:
        vals=[];w=[]
        for el,f in fr.items():
            e=Element(el)
            try: v=getattr(e,pr)
            except: v=None
            if v is None: v=np.nan
            vals.append(float(v)); w.append(f)
        vals=np.array(vals,dtype=float); w=np.array(w)
        m=~np.isnan(vals)
        if m.sum()==0:
            out[pr+'_mean']=np.nan; out[pr+'_min']=np.nan; out[pr+'_max']=np.nan; out[pr+'_range']=np.nan; out[pr+'_std']=np.nan
        else:
            v=vals[m]; ww=w[m]/w[m].sum()
            mu=(v*ww).sum()
            out[pr+'_mean']=mu; out[pr+'_min']=v.min(); out[pr+'_max']=v.max()
            out[pr+'_range']=v.max()-v.min()
            out[pr+'_std']=np.sqrt((ww*(v-mu)**2).sum())
    return out

ANIONS=['O','S','Se','Te','F','Cl','Br','I','N','P','As','Sb']
CATG=['Li','Na','K','Rb','Cs','Be','Mg','Ca','Sr','Ba','Al','Ga','In','Tl','Si','Ge','Sn','Pb','B','C','Zn','Cd','Hg','Cu','Ag','Sc','Y','Ti','Zr','Nb','Ta','W','Bi','V','Mo']

def featurize(pos, formula):
    s=struct(pos)
    comp=s.composition
    f=elem_stats(comp)
    f['natoms']=len(s)
    f['volume_per_atom']=s.volume/len(s)
    f['density']=s.density
    f['nelem']=len(comp.elements)
    abc=sorted(s.lattice.abc)
    f['a']=abc[0]; f['c_over_a']=abc[2]/abc[0]
    ang=s.lattice.angles
    f['ang_std']=np.std(ang)
    fr=comp.fractional_composition.get_el_amt_dict()
    for e in ANIONS+CATG:
        f['f_'+e]=fr.get(e,0.0)
    # anion fraction total
    f['f_chalc']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['O','S','Se','Te'])
    f['f_halide']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['F','Cl','Br','I'])
    f['f_pnic']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['N','P','As','Sb'])
    f['f_alkali']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Li','Na','K','Rb','Cs'])
    f['f_alkearth']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Be','Mg','Ca','Sr','Ba'])
    f['f_d10']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Zn','Cd','Hg','Cu','Ag','Au'])
    f['f_p_block13']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['B','Al','Ga','In','Tl'])
    f['f_lonepair']=sum(fr.get(e,0) for e in ['Tl','Pb','Bi','Sn','Sb','Ge','As','Se','Te','I'])
    # neighbor stats
    try:
        from pymatgen.analysis.local_env import CrystalNN
        pass
    except: pass
    d=s.distance_matrix.copy()
    np.fill_diagonal(d,1e9)
    nn=d.min(axis=1)
    f['nn_mean']=nn.mean(); f['nn_min']=nn.min(); f['nn_std']=nn.std()
    # symmetry
    try:
        from pymatgen.symmetry.analyzer import SpacegroupAnalyzer
        sga=SpacegroupAnalyzer(s,symprec=0.1)
        f['spg']=sga.get_space_group_number()
        f['ncentro']=int(sga.is_laue())
    except Exception:
        f['spg']=0; f['ncentro']=0
    # electronegativity of anion-cation gap
    els=comp.elements
    xs=[e.X for e in els]
    f['X_gap_max']=max(xs)-min(xs)
    return f

def build(df, poscol='poscar'):
    rows=[]
    for i,r in df.iterrows():
        rows.append(featurize(r[poscol], r['formula']))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, index=df.index)

ys=np.log10(t.shg.values+0.05); yg=t.band_gap.values

def mods(seed):
    return [make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=seed,n_estimators=400,max_depth=3,learning_rate=0.05,subsample=0.8)),
            make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),ExtraTreesRegressor(500,random_state=seed)),
            make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(),RandomForestRegressor(500,random_state=seed))]

        for m in mods(seed):
            m.fit(Xtv,y); P.append(m.predict(Xpv))
    P=np.array(P); return P.mean(0), P.std(0)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools
d=pd.read_csv('pool_pred.csv')
n=len(d)
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
sd_s=0.36; sd_g=0.53
mu_s=d.shg_log.values; mu_g=d.gap_pred.values
NS=3000
Sn=np.zeros((NS,n)); Gn=np.zeros((NS,n))
for it in range(NS):
    S=np.clip(10**(mu_s+rng.normal(0,sd_s,n))-0.05,0,None)
    G=np.clip(mu_g+rng.normal(0,sd_g,n),0,None)
    Sn[it]=(S-S.min())/(S.max()-S.min()); Gn[it]=(G-G.min())/(G.max()-G.min())

def hvset(idx):
    # vectorized over draws
    s=Sn[:,idx]; g=Gn[:,idx]
    order=np.argsort(-s,axis=1)
    ss=np.take_along_axis(s,order,1); gg=np.take_along_axis(g,order,1)
    cum=np.maximum.accumulate(gg,axis=1)
    prev=np.concatenate([np.zeros((NS,1)),cum[:,:-1]],axis=1)
    contrib=ss*np.clip(cum-prev,0,None)
    return contrib.sum(1).mean()

# greedy
sel=[]
for k in range(5):
    best=None
    for i in range(n):
        if i in sel: continue
        v=hvset(sel+[i])
        if best is None or v>best[0]: best=(v,i)
    sel.append(best[1]); print(k,d.candidate_id[best[1]],d.formula[best[1]],round(best[0],4))
# local search
improved=True
cur=hvset(sel)
while improved:
    improved=False
    for pos in range(5):
        for i in range(n):
            if i in sel: continue
            trial=sel.copy(); trial[pos]=i
            v=hvset(trial)
            if v>cur+1e-6:
                cur=v; sel=trial; improved=True
print('final HV',cur)
print(d.iloc[sel][['candidate_id','formula','shg_pred','gap_pred']].to_string())
# marginal contributions
for pos in range(5):
    o=[s for j,s in enumerate(sel) if j!=pos]
    print(d.candidate_id[sel[pos]], 'contrib', round(cur-hvset(o),4))

## Approach

**1. Featurization** (`pymatgen`): elemental-property statistics (electronegativity, row/group, radii, electron affinity, Mendeleev no. — weighted mean/min/max/range/std), composition-class fractions (chalcogenide/halide/pnictide, alkali, alkaline-earth, d¹⁰ cations, group-13, lone-pair cations), plus structural descriptors (volume/atom, density, packing via min-neighbor distances, c/a, space group, centrosymmetry flag).

**2. Surrogates**: 10-fold CV on the 200 training materials.
- log₁₀(SHG): GB R² ≈ 0.68, Spearman ≈ 0.78
- band gap: GB R² ≈ 0.81, Spearman ≈ 0.86

Ensemble (GB + ET + RF × 5 seeds) applied to the pool.

**3. Set selection**: Monte-Carlo expected-hypervolume maximization. I sampled residual noise (σ ≈ 0.36 dex for SHG, 0.53 eV for gap), with correlated errors shared among the many near-duplicate polymorph groups (SiC×6, Li₂MgGa₂Se₅×6, …), renormalized (|d|, Eg) per draw, and did greedy + local-search over 5-subsets under 3 normalization schemes (linear, log, rank), restricted to one pick per distinct reduced composition so the set isn't wasted on duplicates.

## Physical reading of the winners

All five are non-centrosymmetric (a hard requirement for χ⁽²⁾ ≠ 0), and they tile the frontier rather than piling onto one axis:
